svg.title: The raw DataFrame from yfinance with MultiIndex columns
svg.desc: Five-row DataFrame indexed by five business dates from 2 January through 8 January 2024 with four columns organised as a two-level MultiIndex, with the outer Adj Close group spanning SPY and QQQ subcolumns and the outer Volume group spanning SPY and QQQ subcolumns; the table shows how the dates jump from Friday 5 January directly to Monday 8 January because weekends are skipped.
svg.text: 5 dates × 4 columns. Notice the gap: Fri 1/5 jumps directly to Mon 1/8 because freq="B" means business days.
The 4 leaf column values in each row map left-to-right to the 4 tuples in MultiIndex order.
